logic.top_level: all (A-G general conditions) AND any-of H (five indications, some with nested all/any)

k_of_n.quote: Severe osteoarthritis of hip joint as evidenced by two or more of the following

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Expressed as positive 'NO' items C-G (no infection, no skin infection/open wound, no implant allergy, no skeletal immaturity, no paraplegia/quadriplegia/progressive neurologic disease) plus relative contraindications in guidelines (BMI > 40, age < 50).
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Revision is H.5 within the same policy; no repeat limits.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: An individual has any of the following conditions: 1. Degenerative joint disease when all of the following exist: ... c. Radiographic evidence of any of the following: i. ... v.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Conditions H.2-H.5 do not need the OA conditions, but criterion A still says the reason must be OA/RA/AVN/post-traumatic arthritis, which conflicts with tumor, fracture, FAI, revision.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Avascular necrosis (osteonecrosis) with greater than stage II with collapse and in stage II avascular necrosis with severe recalcitrant hip pain
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'and' reads as 'or'; staging system not named

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Relative contraindications to joint replacement include the following: Morbid obesity (BMI greater than 40), or age less than 50 years unless there are no other treatment options
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: relative contraindication is not tied to approval or denial; 'exhaust all appropriate nonsurgical treatment'

requirement_kinds.quote: The reason for the arthroplasty is osteoarthritis (OA), rheumatoid arthritis, avascular necrosis (osteonecrosis), or post-traumatic arthritis of the hip
It is NOT for a customized hip replacement ... does NOT use a 'Gender specific' implant
Documentation of failure of conservative therapy ... or documentation of rationale if conservative therapy is considered inappropriate
limited range of motion, antalgic gait, and pain in hip joint with passive range of motion on physical examination
Severe osteoarthritis ... two or more of: subchondral cysts, sclerosis, periarticular osteophytes, joint subluxation, bone on bone articulation, joint space narrowing
AVN greater than stage II with collapse; RA (joint space narrowing)
Tumor involving proximal femur or acetabulum; Unstable fracture of femoral neck or acetabulum; FAI with advanced OA
Previous arthroplasty or resurfacing revision: instability, implant failure, infection, dislocation, displaced fracture, allergy
all of the following unless contraindicated: anti-inflammatories or analgesics; activity modification; supervised PT (may be instructed HEP); weight reduction counseling; assistive device
Morbid obesity (BMI greater than 40), or age less than 50 years
History and physical ... prior conservative treatments, duration, and response ... radiology reports
